population: the 5 of 15 frozen v0.1 packets whose pinned source yields readable passage text
why: Every one of these five sources asserts copyright or a non-commercial licence on its serving page, so witness text is staged outside the repository and only digests, locators, extraction notes and licence notes are committed.
not_covered: 10 of 15 packets (80 of 120 judgments) still have no witness: 5 pinned URLs serve no text, 2 need extraction out of a bulk file, 2 are paywalled and 1 host is unreachable. See process/CALIBRATION_TEXT_RELEASE_QA.md.

witnesses.extraction_note: Livius anchors every fifth translated line as '[n]'; the witness is the contiguous chunk-anchored block from [195] to [240] inclusive, i.e. the numbered lines plus their unnumbered continuation lines, so the passage reads unbroken. The edition's inline 'note[…]' apparatus and the section heading 'The Creation of Man' fall inside that span and are retained as served.
witnesses.licence_as_stated_by_source: 'All content copyright (c) 1995-2026 Livius.org. All rights reserved.'; translation 'adapted from the one by B.R. Foster'

witnesses.extraction_note: Sefaria serves a single-verse reference as a plain string; the one verse is taken verbatim with its footnote apparatus stripped.
witnesses.licence_as_stated_by_source: Sefaria license=CC-BY-NC, THE JPS TANAKH: Gender-Sensitive Edition

witnesses.extraction_note: The page numbers its prose by line-group under each Segment heading; the group '10-14.' under Segment A is the pinned passage and is taken verbatim.

The packet pins Genesis 6-9 but its URL resolves to chapters 7-9, so the witness covers chapters 7, 8 and 9 verse by verse (Genesis 6 is not served at this pin). Verses come from the Sefaria texts API; the edition's footnote markers and the 'footnote' apparatus spans are removed, the verse numbers are the API's own.
witnesses.licence_as_stated_by_source: Sefaria license=CC-BY-NC, THE JPS TANAKH: Gender-Sensitive Edition

witnesses.extraction_note: ETCSL prints each line-group as one prose paragraph; the two pinned groups (Segment C 1-27 and Segment D 1-11) are taken verbatim as whole paragraphs. Damaged signs are printed as '……' by the edition itself.
